newsitem.title: USA: Trump announcement delayed, no new date set.
newsitem.headline: Trump announcement delayed, no new date set.

text.p: An expected press conference with Donald Trump Hotels & Casinos Resorts Inc and the Rank Organisation Plc has yet to be rescheduled after it was postponed late Monday, a Trump spokesman said.
A spokesman for Hard Rock, a unit of Rank, was not immediately available to comment, but his office said the event was postponed due to "logistical" reasons.

The press conference, originally slated for Tuesday, was expected to unveil a $50 million investment by Rank that would be used to retheme Atlantic City's Trump Castle into a Hard Rock Casino Hotel, sources said.
Rank is expected to share in the resort's profits.

The announcement was delayed by Rank on Monday afternoon before a top executive at Trump said the press conference was back on. The spokesman on Wednesday said the announcement was again postponed later on Monday.
Trump shares traded up 1/4 before the close on Wednesday. High-yield debt traders said Trump Castle's debt dipped about one point, however, citing uncertainty over the partnership.
